partners.mechanism_chain: LBR (HGNC:6584) —LEADS_TO→ Severe skeletal dysplasia (HP:0002650); LBR (HGNC:6584) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); LBR (HGNC:6584) —LEADS_TO→ Microcephaly (HP:0000252); STX5 (HGNC:11143) —DISRUPTS→ Protein glycosylation in Golgi apparatus (GO:0006486); Protein glycosylation in Golgi apparatus (GO:0006486) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital disorder of glycosylation (HP:0030101); STX5 (HGNC:11143) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); STX5 (HGNC:11143) —LEADS_TO→ Microcephaly (HP:0000252). Mutations in LBR (Greenberg dysplasia) and STX5 (CDG-IIaa) both converge on the disruption of normal cellular processes. LBR mutations lead to skeletal dysplasia, intellectual disability, and microcephaly. STX5 mutations disrupt protein glycosylation in the Golgi apparatus, also contributing to intellectual disability and microcephaly, and are the defining feature of CDG-IIaa. The overlap in phenotypes (intellectual disability, microcephaly) suggests a shared downstream consequence of disrupted cellular homeostasis, potentially mediated by broad impacts on protein function and cellular development.

partners.mechanism_chain: Lamin B Receptor (HGNC:6570) —DISRUPTS→ Nuclear envelope integrity and chromatin organization (GO:0005654); Nuclear envelope integrity and chromatin organization (GO:0005654) —LEADS_TO→ Skeletal abnormalities (HP:0000001); Nuclear envelope integrity and chromatin organization (GO:0005654) —LEADS_TO→ Abnormal head shape (HP:0000236); p21 (CDKN1A)-activated kinase 2 (HGNC:8567) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0007010); Cytoskeletal regulation (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Eye abnormalities (HP:0000479).
